gloss: to cause, to give rise to

definitions.gloss: to cause, to give rise to, to trigger
definitions.explanation: To bring about an event, situation, or condition, often something problematic.

definitions.gloss: to help up, to raise up
definitions.explanation: To physically help someone who has fallen to stand up.

examples.japanese: {不注意|ふちゅうい}が{事故|じこ}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こした。
この{薬|くすり}は{副作用|ふくさよう}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす{可能性|かのうせい}がある。
examples.english: This medicine may cause side effects.

examples.japanese: {経済危機|けいざいきき}が{社会不安|しゃかいふあん}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こしている。
examples.english: The economic crisis is causing social unrest.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んだ{子供|こども}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こしてあげた。
examples.english: I helped the child who had fallen get up.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Compound verb: {引|ひ}く + {起|お}こす. Pattern: Xを{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause X / help X up).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing situation or resulting state. {引|ひ}き{起|お}こしている = 'is causing' or 'has caused.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{問題|もんだい}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause a problem)
・{事故|じこ}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause an accident)
・{反発|はんぱつ}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (provoke opposition)
・{副作用|ふくさよう}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こす (cause side effects)

NOTE: Sense 1 (to cause) is much more common than sense 2 (to help up). Often used for negative events or consequences.
